summary: First testing-agent run for DU-NZO platform Commands 1-7. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass — /api/health, /api/leads, /api/plans/preview, Copilot SSE streaming, Copilot multi-turn statefulness (session recalled 'Zephyr'), and /api/copilot/history ordering. Frontend: all critical flows verified at 1920x1080 — platform shell renders without marketing nav/footer leak, 9 sidebar nav links route correctly, theme toggle switches dark(rgb 6,7,14)->light(rgb 246,247,251) and persists after reload (localStorage dunzo.platform.theme), controls table row opens control-drawer with mark-reviewed + Escape close, risk heat-cell filter + risk-drawer open, Cmd/Ctrl+K and global-search both open command-menu, Copilot panel streams a real compliance-domain assistant reply (SOC 2 answer, 339 chars), Evidence export triggered a 'dunzo-audit-pack-2026-10-01.html' download, Alert->Action flow on /monitoring then /app shows new action-row-alert-al-1. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Copilot history context is injected as a text blob in the user message (lines 307-316) instead of using LlmChat native message history — works for 8-turn window but will grow unwieldy and token-heavy; consider native multi-turn API when available.
COPILOT history endpoint caps at 200 messages (line 286) with no pagination — fine for demo, but add cursor-based pagination before scale.
load_dotenv() called before reading os.environ — correct order; EMERGENT_LLM_KEY correctly guarded with 503 if missing.
React Router v6 future-flag warnings in console (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) — non-blocking but should opt-in before React Router v7.
server.py is 522 lines — still manageable but approaching the 700-line threshold where splitting into routers (copilot.py, plans.py, leads.py, admin.py) would help maintainability.
test_credentials: No auth yet (JWT = Command 8). EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is pre-set in /app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed leads and TEST_ copilot sessions via API. Mongo-backed copilot_messages collection accumulates test sessions — safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Commands 1-7 flows pass. The command-menu is opened via BOTH Cmd/Ctrl+K and clicking [data-testid=global-search]. Note: when the Copilot panel is already open, it can overlay the global-search area — tests opening the command-menu should first close any open copilot-panel (Escape) to avoid z-index interference (observed once during combined test flow, not a product bug per se but a UX overlap worth monitoring). Theme state lives in localStorage key 'dunzo.platform.theme' (values 'dark'|'light') and is applied via CSS vars/classes NOT on <html> or <body> — verify via computed background of [data-testid=platform-app] (dark=rgb(6,7,14), light=rgb(246,247,251)).
